inlines.v: MANT'LET, noun [dim. of mantle.] A small cloke worn by women. 1. In fortification, a kind of movable parapet or penthouse, made of planks, nailed one over another to the highth of almost six feet, cased with tin and set on wheels. In a siege, this is driven before pioneers, to protect them from the enemy's small shot.
